description: Sequence of decision cards with navigation, gestures and explicit actions.

howToUse: Use it to decide on items one at a time, like or skip: candidates, listings, suggestions.
Save each decision in `onAction`. The buttons do the same as the gesture, so people who do not swipe can decide too.
Offer to start over in `onReset` when the cards end. In new code, import it as DecisionDeck.
alternatives: Comparing several items side by side: a grid of ContentCard.

props.name: instructions
props.description: "hidden" removes the gesture and keyboard instructions from the screen and keeps them for screen readers.
